sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: 24 Pieces of Heart; every 4 add one heart. Link starts with 3 hearts, max 20.

items.name: Lost Woods hideout
items.howTo: In the east of the Lost Woods, cut the 3 × 3 patch of bushes north-east of the thieves' den and drop into the hole under it.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #1, StrategyWiki #1, Zelda Wiki #1. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Kakariko well
items.howTo: Drop into the well from the ledge behind it and bomb the cracked north wall beside the chests.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #2, StrategyWiki #2, Zelda Wiki #10. Needs: Bombs.

items.name: Blind's Hideout basement
items.howTo: In the basement of the thieves' house in the north of Kakariko, bomb the cracked wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #3, StrategyWiki #3, Zelda Wiki #11. Needs: Bombs. Zelda Dungeon puts the cracked wall to the right, StrategyWiki on the north.

items.name: 15-Second Game
items.howTo: Bomb the wall between the Quarreling Brothers' rooms in the south of Kakariko, leave through the left room and finish the maze race outside in 15 seconds or less. Jumping the fence saves time.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #4, StrategyWiki #4, Zelda Wiki #12. Needs: Bombs.

items.name: Great Swamp pond
items.howTo: In the Swamp Ruins, push the blocks and pull the right-hand switch to drain the pond outside; the piece is at its bottom.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #5, StrategyWiki #5, Zelda Wiki #17. Needs: nothing.

items.name: Aginah's cave
items.howTo: In Aginah's cave, right of the Desert Palace, bomb the cracked south wall.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #6, StrategyWiki #7, Zelda Wiki #14. Needs: Bombs.

items.name: Cave under the rocks west of the Sanctuary
items.howTo: On the cliff west of the Sanctuary, dash into the pile of rocks with the Pegasus Shoes and take the stairs under it to the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #7, StrategyWiki #6, Zelda Wiki #9. Needs: Pegasus Shoes.

items.name: Desert Palace ledge
items.howTo: Leave the Desert Palace by its west door and walk south along the cliff.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #8, StrategyWiki #8, Zelda Wiki #16. Needs: Book of Mudora.

items.name: Zora's River ledge
items.howTo: After buying the Flippers, swim back down the river from King Zora and turn west before the second waterfall to the fenced ledge.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #9, StrategyWiki #9, Zelda Wiki #7. Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Spectacle Rock cave
items.howTo: Drop off the ledge below Spectacle Rock and go into the cave there.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #10, StrategyWiki #10, Zelda Wiki #4. Needs: Power Glove.

items.name: Top of Spectacle Rock
items.howTo: In the Dark World, stand on the spot matching Spectacle Rock's eastern eye and use the Magic Mirror.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #11, StrategyWiki #11, Zelda Wiki #3. Needs: Magic Mirror.

items.name: Lumberjacks' tree
items.howTo: After Agahnim, dash into the dead tree by the Lumberjacks' house with the Pegasus Shoes, take the stairs and go through the door on the right.
items.after: After Agahnim at Hyrule Castle Tower
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #12, StrategyWiki #13, Zelda Wiki #2. Needs: Pegasus Shoes.

items.name: Pyramid of Power ledge
items.howTo: On the lowest ledge of the Pyramid's east side.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #13, StrategyWiki #12, Zelda Wiki #24. Needs: access to the Dark World.

items.name: Cave south of the Haunted Grove
items.howTo: In the Dark World, use the Magic Mirror from the oval of flowers south of the Haunted Grove to land on the Light World plateau with the cave.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #14, StrategyWiki #15, Zelda Wiki #15. Needs: Magic Mirror.

items.name: Lake Hylia island
items.howTo: Swim to the stone circle in the north-west of the Dark World's Ice Lake and use the Magic Mirror to land on the islet in Lake Hylia.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #15, StrategyWiki #14, Zelda Wiki #18. Needs: Zora's Flippers, Magic Mirror.

items.name: Graveyard ledge cave
items.howTo: In the Dark World, climb the ladder north of the Ghostly Garden and use the Magic Mirror to land on the ledge above the Graveyard, then bomb the wall of the cave there.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #16, StrategyWiki #16, Zelda Wiki #8. Needs: Magic Mirror, Bombs. To reach the ladder Zelda Dungeon lists the Pegasus Shoes or the Titan's Mitt, StrategyWiki the Magic Hammer.

items.name: Treasure Chest Game
items.howTo: Pay 30 Rupees in the house with chests on its roof and open two of the 16 chests; the piece is one of the random prizes.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #17, StrategyWiki #18, Zelda Wiki #20. Needs: 30 Rupees a game. StrategyWiki also lists the Magic Hammer.

items.name: Digging Game
items.area: South of the Village of Outcasts
items.howTo: Pay 80 Rupees and dig for 30 seconds with the keeper's shovel; the piece is buried at random.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #18, StrategyWiki #17, Zelda Wiki #22. Needs: 80 Rupees a game. GBA: you can jump the right-hand fence and walk back in to keep digging.

items.name: Bumper Cave ledge
items.howTo: Go through the cave at the foot of Dark World Death Mountain, cross the gap and pass the Bumper with the Magic Cape to come out on the ledge.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #19, StrategyWiki #20, Zelda Wiki #19. Needs: Magic Cape. Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon also need the Hookshot; StrategyWiki lists the Power Glove instead.

items.name: Stake Garden cave
items.area: Stake Garden (south of the Smithy ruins)
items.howTo: Lift the dark rock with the Titan's Mitt and pound all 22 stakes with the Magic Hammer; a cave opens with the piece.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #20, StrategyWiki #19, Zelda Wiki #21. Needs: Titan's Mitt, Magic Hammer.

items.name: Mire Shed
items.area: Swamp of Evil (west of Misery Mire)
items.howTo: In the cave left of the Misery Mire entrance, solve the block puzzle and open the left chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #21, StrategyWiki #21, Zelda Wiki #23. Needs: Flute, Titan's Mitt. Zelda Wiki's prose counts 19 Light and 5 Dark World pieces, but its table, Zelda Dungeon and StrategyWiki all put this one in the Dark World: 18 and 6.

items.name: Checkerboard cave
items.howTo: From the dead end in the north-east of the Swamp of Evil, use the Magic Mirror to land on the desert ridge, lift the rock with the Titan's Mitt and enter the cave.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #22, StrategyWiki #22, Zelda Wiki #13. Needs: Flute, Titan's Mitt, Magic Mirror.

items.name: Floating island
items.howTo: Take the cave under the rock on Dark World East Death Mountain, cross its invisible bridge, bomb through and leave by the south, then use the Magic Mirror to land on the island above.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #23, StrategyWiki #23, Zelda Wiki #5. Needs: Power Glove, Magic Mirror, Bombs.

items.name: Mimic Cave
items.howTo: Partway through Turtle Rock, step out onto its ledge and use the Magic Mirror to land on the Light World balcony. Defeat the four Goriyas inside.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #24, StrategyWiki #24, Zelda Wiki #6. Needs: Magic Mirror, and the way into Turtle Rock (Quake Medallion, Cane of Somaria). GBA: Eyegores instead of Goriyas.

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: The Sanctuary's and one from each of the 10 bosses; Agahnim gives none. Boss containers can't be skipped.

items.name: Sanctuary chest
items.howTo: The Loyal Sage gives you the chest by the altar after you bring Zelda to the Sanctuary.
